notes: Answers computed from labels.csv by build_eval.py. Amounts in INR.

radar_next_30_days.name: Credit card bill (September purchases so far)

questions.question: How much did I actually spend in August?
questions.answer_text: You actually spent about Rs 50,541 in August.
questions.method: Sum spend_effect for August. Excludes own transfers, credit card bill payments and money lent to friends. Nets refunds, reversals and friends' split repayments.
traps: Adding bank debits AND card purchases gives 64743.0 (double counts the card bill).

questions.question: What was my total income in July?
questions.answer_text: Your July income was Rs 51,000 (salary 45,000 + freelance 6,000).
questions.method: Sum income_effect for July (salary + freelance). Refunds and friends' repayments are not income.

questions.question: Where did I spend the most money in August?
questions.answer_text: Shopping was the biggest category in August at Rs 14,298.
questions.method: Largest true_category by spend_effect in August (rent is a category too).

questions.question: What were my top 3 spending categories in August?
questions.method: Top three categories by spend_effect in August.

questions.question: What expenses increased compared with last month?
questions.method: Compare like-for-like days (1-18 Sep vs 1-18 Aug) because September is only 18 days old. spend_effect by category. change_pct is null when last month's amount was zero (new spending).
traps: Comparing full August with part of September makes almost everything look lower. A good answer notes the period or compares equal days.

questions.question: How much more did I spend on food this month than at the same point last month?
questions.method: Food & Dining true spend, 1-18 Sep vs 1-18 Aug.

questions.question: Which subscriptions am I paying for?

bonus: Amazon Prime (annual Rs 1,499, single charge in the data)

questions.method: Recurring digital subscriptions across bank AND card statements.
traps: Netflix, iCloud and Canva are on the credit card only; Spotify is on the bank only.

questions.question: How much do I spend on subscriptions every month?
questions.method: Sum of current monthly amounts (Netflix at the new price).

questions.question: Did any of my subscriptions get more expensive?
questions.method: Price history in recurring_truth.json.

questions.question: What do my subscriptions cost per year?
questions.method: Monthly total x 12 (with or without the Prime annual charge; either is acceptable if stated).

questions.question: What payments are coming up in the next 7 days?
questions.method: Recurring bank obligations due 19-25 Sep.
traps: Jio recharge repeats every 28 days, not on a calendar-month day.

questions.question: How much of my money is already committed in the next 30 days?

breakdown.name: Credit card bill (September purchases so far)
breakdown.note: lower bound; more card spending may follow

questions.method: Known recurring bank obligations due 19 Sep - 18 Oct + the card bill due 8 Oct (September purchases so far). Card-billed subscriptions (Netflix, iCloud, Canva) are NOT added again: they are inside the card bill.
traps: Adding Netflix/iCloud/Canva on top of the card bill double counts them.

questions.question: How much can I safely spend per day until my next salary?
questions.answer_text: About Rs 540 per day for the next 12 days.
questions.method: (closing balance - obligations due before salary - Rs 2,000 buffer) / days until salary. The Oct 8 card bill is after salary so it is not deducted here.

questions.question: Can I afford a Rs 4,500 purchase today?
questions.method: Recompute safe-to-spend with the purchase deducted. Agent should present the trade-off, not a verdict.

questions.question: Am I over budget anywhere this month?
questions.method: September true spend (1-18 Sep) vs monthly budgets in profile.json.

questions.question: How much of my food budget have I used?
questions.method: Food & Dining spend in September vs its Rs 6,000 budget.

questions.question: When will I reach my laptop goal?
questions.answer_text: About 12 months at Rs 4,000 a month.
questions.method: ceil((60,000 - 15,000) / 4,000). Deterministic arithmetic; never let the LLM do this itself.

questions.question: What if I save Rs 1,500 more every month, when do I reach the laptop goal?
How much did my friends pay back for the August 16 dinner, and what was my own share?
questions.method: Dinner debit minus three UPI repayments (Ananya, Karthik, Meera).

questions.question: Who still owes me money?

expected.from: two friends for the 12 Sep movie tickets
expected.note: Rahul repaid the Rs 2,000 on 6 Aug

questions.method: Movie split (total 1,120, my share 280, received 280) leaves 560 pending. The Rahul loan is settled. Needs the pending_splits entry in profile.json (created after the user confirms the split).

questions.question: Do I have any duplicate charges?
questions.method: Same merchant, same amount, same day on the card statement.

questions.question: Was there any unusually large purchase recently?
questions.method: Largest non-fixed single purchase, far above typical shopping amounts. Rent (12,000) is fixed/recurring.

questions.question: How much did I put on my credit card in August?
questions.method: Card purchases (net of refunds) dated in August.

questions.question: How much have I paid towards my credit card bills, and does that count as spending?
questions.method: Bank debits of type cc_payment. They settle earlier card purchases, so counting them again double counts.

questions.question: How much cash did I take out from ATMs?
questions.method: ATM WDL rows.

questions.question: How much have I received in refunds?
questions.method: true_type == refund (the failed-payment reversal of Rs 640 is a reversal, not a refund).

questions.question: What was my average monthly food spending from June to August?
questions.method: Mean of Food & Dining true spend for Jun, Jul, Aug.

questions.question: How much did I spend on flights?

expected.behavior: say there are no flight or travel transactions; never invent a number

questions.method: No flight/travel merchants exist in the data.

questions.question: Which stock should I buy with my savings?

expected.behavior: decline investment advice; stay within decision support; offer spending/goal help instead

questions.method: Problem statement forbids investment advice.

questions.question: August mein sabse zyada paisa kahan gaya?
questions.method: Same as Q03, asked in Hinglish. Agent should answer correctly (ideally in the same language).

questions.question: Did I spend more on Swiggy or Zomato in August?
questions.method: By true_merchant across bank UPI and credit card, net of the Swiggy refund.
